criteria.doc:
SL5g #3 — failure-cause classification of VLA-only success -> pb4/pb5 failure episodes (CPU, .venv-ag3s).

Inputs: failure_logs.json, mj_probe_LI.json, mj_probe_LIBERO10.json (object tracks), episode npz small arrays, calls logs.
Output: outputs/verify/SL5g/failure_classes.json

Numeric criteria (obs = observation index incl. wait; LI wait 20, LIBERO10 wait 10):
  grasped(obs)  = both finger sides touch the target body (MuJoCo contact, dist <= 0)
  lifted(obs)   = grasped and target z - z(wait) >= LIFT_MM
  lost          = after the first lifted obs, >= LOST_RUN consecutive obs with no grasp and rise < LIFT_MM
  over-lift     = max target rise > OVERLIFT_MM (VLA-only success episodes, both sets: max rise <= 186.3 mm)
Classes (first match wins):
  A_no_lift_hold     : never lifted, and longest HOLD run >= N_HOLD calls
  A_no_lift_other    : never lifted, longest HOLD run < N_HOLD
  B_lifted_lost      : lifted, lost
  C_lifted_overlift  : lifted, not lost, max rise > OVERLIFT_MM
  D_lifted_other     : lifted, not lost, max rise <= OVERLIFT_MM

n4_contact_phase_neighbours.selection: calls with to.minimal_intervention.applied False and reference_clearance_m < 0 and grasp.state in latched/closing/held; arm at each of the 5 reference rows; bodies within 30 mm (geom_margin 30 mm on non-robot geoms) of a gripper0 geom (SL5e format) / of a robot0_link geom (arm_links)

definitions.collide_t: env step (wait incl.) after which the obstacle displacement first exceeds 1 mm (client CollisionMonitor)
definitions.call: chunk_index[collide_t] (the call whose chunk executed that step)
definitions.contact_body: robot body or the task target body with the smallest MuJoCo distance to an obstacle geom (margin 10 mm) over obs collide_t-1 .. collide_t+2
